origin.summary: Workout 3 of the 2013 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: The same high-rep wall-ball, double-under, and muscle-up triplet as 12.4, reused the following year.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2013/3 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
